description: The Datacryptor® 2000 is a standalone multi-chip cryptographic module that secures communications using signed Diffie-Hellman key exchange and Triple-DES or AES encryption over point-to-point links, X.25, Frame Relay, and IP networks. The unit also provides integrated secure unit management capability.
